Now I understand the state machine. The key issue is at line 514: `TINFL_CR_RETURN(53, TINFL_STATUS_HAS_MORE_OUTPUT)` inside the `while (counter--)` loop. When this returns, `r->m_counter` is set to `counter` (the remaining count), and `r->m_dist_from_out_buf_start` is set to `dist_from_out_buf_start`.

When the function is called again, it resumes at `case 53:`. Let me look at what happens at case 53 and how the state is restored.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=command>sed -n '180,230p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/miniz/miniz_tinfl.c</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
